name: Computer Science and Psychology
about: The combined major in Computer Science and Psychology is designed for students interested in the intersection of computation and human cognition. The program provides a strong foundation in both computer science and psychology, with core courses in algorithms, data structures, systems programming, cognitive psychology, perception, and neuroscience. Students explore topics at the interface of the two fields, such as artificial intelligence, human-computer interaction, computational modeling of cognition, and machine learning. The major prepares students for careers in technology, user experience research, cognitive science, and graduate study in related fields.
